testCases.title: Filter by Selected Category
steps: Select a valid category from the filter options.
expectedResults: Items corresponding to the selected category are displayed.

testCases.title: Filter by Non-Existent Category
steps: Select a non-existent category from the filter options.
expectedResults: An empty result set is displayed.

testCases.title: Remove Category Filter
expectedResults: The original list of items is displayed.
